title: Time Enough for Love
author: Robert A. Heinlein
summary: Lazarus Long, who has lived for over two thousand years, is persuaded to record his memories rather than die. Interwoven with frame scenes, the book offers tales of his life and Heinlein's musings on love, freedom and living.
readIf: you enjoy Heinlein's talky, sprawling later novels and a charismatic old narrator.
skipIf: you dislike dated sexual politics or digressive books that are partly philosophy.
